guard: the topology lens overlays only a membership feed the viewer actually read, and names a failed read as its own
why: A fold that draws a snapshot the viewer could not re-read shows a stale skeleton as live truth; an absent bucket reported as unreadable makes every daemon-less mesh look broken; a pill that checks the snapshot before the failure hides a failed read behind traffic-only; display-name keys collapse distinct principals and union their subscriptions.

Each mutation is compile-clean and unique in the named file. The suite imports the CLI source directly and `MeshView` from the built @cotal-ai/workspace, so a MeshView mutation builds workspace first and rebuilds it after the restore.
M6 to M8 cover a durable family row (#5404): it expands over the durable-class channels the lens knows, and MeshView carries each channel's class for that.

mutations.name: M1 draw the overlay from a feed the viewer could not read
mutations.find: const membership = opts?.membership?.unreadable === undefined ? opts?.membership?.snapshot : undefined;
mutations.expectRed: an unreadable feed draws NO membership links, even with a last snapshot in hand
mutations.cell: an unreadable feed draws NO membership links, even with a last snapshot in hand

mutations.name: M2 report an absent bucket as a failed read
mutations.expectRed: an absent bucket (no daemon) is traffic-only, not unreadable
mutations.cell: an absent bucket (no daemon) is traffic-only, not unreadable

mutations.name: M3 check the snapshot before the failure
M4 key authoritative members by display name instead of endpoint id
mutations.expectRed: two principals with one display name remain two topology nodes
mutations.cell: two principals with one display name remain two topology nodes

mutations.name: M5 a watch that closes after setup lands nowhere
mutations.expectRed: a watch that closes after setup is named as the watch's failure, never as a connection error
mutations.cell: a watch that closes after setup is named as the watch's failure, never as a connection error

mutations.name: M6 a durable family row is drawn as a hub of its own instead of expanding
mutations.find: else for (const c of durable) if (!chans.has(c) && subjectMatches(ch, c)) chans.set(c, "durable");
mutations.expectRed: an offline family follower gets a durable link to each durable-class channel under it, and none to a live one
mutations.cell: an offline family follower gets a durable link to each durable-class channel under it, and none to a live one
mutations.note: The lens would draw a channel named team.> and no link to the channels the follower stores copies for.

mutations.name: M7 a durable family row expands over every known channel, live-class ones included
mutations.find: else for (const c of durable) if
mutations.replace: else for (const c of known) if
mutations.expectRed: an offline family follower gets a durable link to each durable-class channel under it, and none to a live one
mutations.cell: an offline family follower gets a durable link to each durable-class channel under it, and none to a live one
mutations.note: An offline follower would show a durable link to team.qa, a live-class channel where it stores nothing.

mutations.name: M8 MeshView channel rows lose their class
mutations.expectRed: the channel rows carry each channel's class from the endpoint
mutations.cell: the channel rows carry each channel's class from the endpoint
mutations.note: The lens would hand foldTopo no durable channels, so no family row would expand.
